is Held In

Property

The relation that obtains between an entity e and an eventuality e' if and only if e is controlled by or subordinated to some other entity in the context of e'

Specialisation

Asserting a sub-property asserts its own domain and range, not just the parent's. Anything you put either side is taken to be of the narrower class, whether or not you said so.
